column1: # Hand-maintained corrections of LexiqueMixte.tsv rows (same format and replay as mixteCorrections.tsv, which is generated from
# the accepted decisions and must not be edited by hand; this file is the home of the rows found by hand). Loaded by
# `loadAllMixteCorrections` (src/mixtecorrections.py); a key present in both files, or matching no output row, fails the build.
# manual-stray-glide-i (2026-10-09): the 26 rows where Mixte had a stray `i` before the glide (`contorsionnait` ...sijonE, not ...sjonE;
#   `ij` -> `j`, `industrialis-` `ij` -> `i`), and `riant` Rj@ -> Rij@. Letters follow Lexique383 (no `=`); closed `O` kept.
